decisionsTitle: «La retrimitere»: the box «Zile (opțional)» beside an invitation's «Retrimite» becomes a list of deadlines by their day and hour (amending §647)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-10, with a screenshot of «Invitații» and a red frame around the column of boxes «Zile (opțional)»:** «nu înțeleg ce înseamnă asta».

**What the box was.** §647's «Retrimite» takes an optional number of days: empty, the deadline stays; a number moves it to that many days from now, at most the start, and only when that is later — and never for a counted place while anybody eligible waits (the invitations review of 2026-10-03), when the row drew no box. The row said none of it: a bare number box labelled «Zile (opțional)» before the button. Days of what, counted from when, what an empty box does, and that it belongs to «Retrimite» and not to «Retrage» were said only by the dialog, after the press. **Amends §647** (how the days are asked, and what they are counted from).

**How the words were chosen.** Three proposals were written independently — the box's own words (a label, grey words in the empty box, a sentence under it); the cell as a sentence («Retrimite» «și, dacă vrei, mută termenul la» [ ] «zile de acum.»); a list resting on «Nu, rămâne cel de acum» with «Da: peste 3 / 7 / 14 zile de acum» — and each was read by two fresh readers who were shown only the screen's words: six readings. All six understood what the control is for, that leaving it keeps the deadline, and that «Retrage» is not concerned. All six stumbled on the same two things: «zile de acum» was read as days added to the deadline as readily as days from today, and no screen showed the day that results — «I have to count the days myself». The list's «prelungești» was read as «add three days». And the dialog's «Termenul devine peste 3 zile de acum, dacă e mai târziu decât cel de acum» gave a condition where the reader wanted the outcome, with «de acum» in two senses. A first list of days was then reviewed against the server from four sides, and that review is why a line carries its hour and why the days are counted from the page's draw (below).

**Decision.** The box becomes a native list, «La retrimitere», in the same place.

1. **It rests on «Termenul rămâne»** (posting `days` empty). Every other line is a deadline by its day and hour — «Termen nou: joi, 19 nov., 14:42» — one line a day, and the last, once the days reach it, «Termen nou: la start, sâm., 21 nov., 09:00». Nobody counts days, and no line says «zile de acum».
2. **A line names exactly the moment its press stores.** `domain/invitations.ts#resendDeadlineChoices` asks the server's own arithmetic (`invitationDeadline`) for each whole number of days from the moment the page is drawn, up to the 60 of §647. The form posts that moment (`drawnAt`), and `resendInvitationByStaff` counts the days from it (`countedFrom`) — so a press after midnight, or the next morning from a tab left open, stores the day and hour the line named and not a day later. Counted from the press, as before, every line of a page drawn at 23:50 and pressed at 00:10 stored the day after the one it showed.
3. **The anchor only ever brings a deadline earlier than the press alone would.** It is never a moment still to come (then, and with no `drawnAt` at all — a `days` post by hand — the days count from the press, as they always did), so nothing is reachable with it that the days did not already reach; the deadline still never moves earlier than it was, never past the start, and never for a counted place while somebody waits.
4. **One line a day, each on a later day than the deadline it replaces** — on the event's clock. Never a later minute of the same day (seven days on an invitation sent with seven an hour ago), never two reaches on one day (the night the clocks go back), never the start's own day beside «la start»: whenever the sixty days reach the start, its day is that line's alone, the Sunday of twenty-five hours included. «La start» is the one line a day may share with the deadline it replaces — offered whenever the days reach the start and the start is later than that deadline, on the deadline's own day too.
5. **No list where the deadline cannot move:** a counted place while anybody eligible waits (as before, when there was no box); when no later deadline is left — the deadline is already the start, or sixty days end on its own day short of the start; and on an event that is not scheduled, where every resend is refused. The Organizer has no «Retrimite» at all (§289).
6. **The question names its outcome.** With the list left alone, «Termenul rămâne: mar., 17 nov. 2026, la 10:00.»; with a line chosen, the line's own words — «Termen nou: joi, 19 nov., 14:42.» — read from the list at the press, so the question repeats the day and hour and nobody has to remember what they picked (`ConfirmSpec.fillFromChosen`: a list's chosen line, where `fillFrom` gives a typed value). The question for a counted place while somebody waits is unchanged. **And the message after the press tells the truth when the line's promise could not be kept:** a deadline moved later from another page meanwhile — a second tab, another Administrator — stays, since a resend never takes time back, and the message says so: «Termenul ales nu s-a aplicat: între timp, termenul a fost mutat mai târziu de altcineva sau din altă filă. Termenul valabil, cel din email, e pe rândul invitației.» (`kept: "alreadyLater"`). The one for somebody waiting (the invitations review of 2026-10-03) is reworded beside it, to the same shape: «Termenul ales nu s-a aplicat: cineva așteaptă pe lista de așteptare. Termenul valabil, cel din email, e pe rândul invitației.» Its «Termenul a rămas cel de acum» was read by four fresh readers as the deadline they had seen, or the one they had just chosen; and all four asked which deadline the email carries — the one in force, read when the email is rendered, which the message now says. The very deadline the line names, reached meanwhile, gets the plain message. An event's start moved between the draw and the press is not announced: the deadline is the start as it stands under the lock, and the row shows it.
7. The form still posts `days`, empty or a whole number, with JavaScript off too (a native `<select>`); a number posted by hand is validated and guarded as it always was, under the lock. From 1200 pixels the list, «Retrimite» and «Retrage» share a line, as the box did; narrower, «Retrimite» goes under the list, and below 900 «Retrage» may go under too — the list is wider than the box, and pushed a tablet's page sideways by 7 pixels at 768 until that was measured; with it the page now fits from 680 pixels, where before the branch it fitted from about 750. On a phone the list is as wide as the person's block. The closed list shows a chosen line whole from 900 pixels up, in both languages (360 pixels: the longest «la start» line of a year, 311, and the control's own 46); narrower, a long line can lose its end there — the start's hour first — while the opened list and the question always carry it whole.

**Refused.**

- *The box's own words* — label «Zile de acum până la termenul nou», grey «gol: termenul rămâne», a sentence under it: three texts on every open row, and its readers still counted days.
- *The cell as a sentence:* a box with no label, and «la … zile de acum» is the phrase the readers tripped on.
- *Three fixed reaches (3, 7, 14 days):* most days could no longer be chosen, and a list of days costs nothing more to read.
- *A line by its day alone, with «(peste 9 zile)» beside it* — the first list: a deadline named by its day reads as the end of that day, while it falls at the hour of the draw; and with the days counted from the press the day itself was wrong after a midnight.
- *Refusing a press from a page drawn on another day,* so that it is drawn again: a refusal for a choice the server can simply honour.
- *A question per line, to name its day:* up to sixty question texts per invitation in the page; the dialog reads the chosen line instead.
- *«Termenul se mută la ziua aleasă în listă (zile de acum: 9)»* in the question — the first list's: its readers called it a leftover and had to remember the day they picked.
- *Shorter lines for a phone* («Nou: joi, 19 nov., 14:42», or no weekday), so that the closed list never cuts one: the words were chosen by readers, a list has one set of lines for every screen, and the question repeats the line whole.
- *Refusing a press whose line can no longer be kept* (the deadline moved later meanwhile, the start moved): the email is what was asked for and leaves; the message says when the deadline stayed.
- *Posting a date in place of days, or a day computed in the browser:* `days` stays the one thing the server validates, and the page works without a script.

**Consequences.** `src/modules/registrations/domain/invitations.ts` (`resendDeadlineChoices`, `ResendDeadlineChoice`; one day formatter per zone, since a list asks up to sixty days per open invitation), `service.ts#resendInvitationByStaff` (`countedFrom`), `admin-service.ts#resendInvitation`, the action (`drawnAt`), `ui/InvitationsPanel.tsx` (the list and its questions), `src/shared/feedback/notice.ts` (`fillFromChosen`; `fillFromForm` takes the chosen lines) and `src/shared/forms/ActionFormIsland.tsx` (reads the chosen line of a `<select>` at the press), `messages/{ro,en}.json` (`Admin.invitations`: `resendWhen`, `resendKeep`, `resendMove`, `resendMoveStart` new; `resendBody` and `resendBodyKept` reworded; `resendDays` gone; `Feedback.toast.invitationResentAlreadyLater` new; `Feedback.toast.invitationResentKept` reworded; the guide's step names «La retrimitere» and «Termenul rămâne» and says when the list is missing — the deadline already as late as it can be, or a place taken while somebody waits, where a special guest's list is shown all the same), `src/i18n/dates.ts` (`calendarDayIn`), `AGENTS.md` §15.11 (two phrases), `SETUP.md` (the invitations procedure names the list). **No migration, no dependency.** The code names this decision by its title, «La retrimitere», not by a number: the branch carries two entries, and the landing numbers a branch's placeholders with its first.

**Tests.** Unit (`registrations/invitations.test.ts`): the choices for an invitation an hour old (eight to sixty days, never the seventh); the start once and last, its own day left to it — on the event's clock, for a start just after midnight too, and at the sixty days' edge when the sixtieth reach is the start — and kept as a line when sixty days end there short of the start; the start on the deadline's own day and nothing once the deadline is the start; nothing once the event has started; «a later day» on the event's clock and not UTC's, for the new deadline and for the one it replaces; one line a day on the nights the clocks change, the Sunday of twenty-five hours with the start at its end — exactly a day's reach on, and a quarter of an hour later — among them; days across a New Year; every choice the server's own arithmetic from the draw; the words in both languages, the old ones gone, the guide's step whole. Integration on PGlite (`registrations/invitation-resend-list.test.ts`), the panel as the server draws it and the real action pressed with the form's own fields: the list's name, the line it rests on, that it is the browser's own list, each line in Romanian and English, and the draw's moment in the form; the start's day once and a start forty days away; a list of one line when the start is the only later deadline, with its two questions and its press; a page drawn after midnight, read on the event's clock; **each line pressed twenty minutes later, after midnight and the next morning stores exactly the moment it named**; the list left alone keeps the deadline and still sends the email; a post without a usable `drawnAt` — none, no instant, a day without its time — or with one still to come, counts from the press; an old draw never moves a deadline earlier, and the answer and the message say the deadline stayed; two pages open on one invitation — the deadline moved later from one, the other's earlier line pressed: it stays, the message says why, and the very deadline reached meanwhile gets the plain message; every outcome read exactly; the questions word for word in both languages — the deadline kept with its moment, a chosen line and the start repeated in their own words — each with its email line; no list for a counted place while somebody waits (the waiting question, word for word) while a special guest keeps hers and its own questions; no list and one question when no later day is left — the deadline already the start, or sixty days ending on its own day, where the question names the deadline and not the start — and on a cancelled event, whose press is refused; no «Retrimite» for the Organizer, whose press of the Administrator's own form is refused. Unit, shared (`shared/feedback-notice.test.ts`, `shared/action-form-confirm.test.ts`): a list's `{field}` is filled with its chosen line's words, never its value, beside a typed value and in the body alone; the island reads the line from the `<select>` itself. Reviewed adversarially before release — truth against the server, the words, the layout and the house guards, and the tests by mutation: forty-two deliberate breakages of the code, each failing a test — read twice more by fresh readers, and reviewed once more as pushed, which is where the message after the press, the start's day on the long Sunday, the widths and the guide's sentence come from; those last words were then read three times over by fresh readers until the message and the step stopped being read two ways. Looked at in the running site from 320 to 1440 pixels, in both languages.
changelogLine: - **«La retrimitere» on an invitation** — the box «Zile (opțional)» beside «Retrimite» is now a list: «Termenul rămâne», or a new deadline by its day and hour — «Termen nou: joi, 19 nov., 14:42» — up to «la start». The line you choose is the deadline you get, whenever you press, and the question asked before the email leaves repeats it. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 28's «with days typed»: the days are chosen in a list. Given an open invitation's row for an Administrator on a scheduled event, when it renders, then beside «Retrimite» the list «La retrimitere» rests on «Termenul rămâne», which posts `days` empty, and offers, one line a day, the moment each whole number of days from the page's draw reaches — up to 60 — when that is a later day, on the event's clock, than the deadline the invitation has: each by its day and hour («Termen nou: joi, 19 nov., 14:42»), ending once at «la start» when the days reach it and the start is later than that deadline — on the deadline's own day too, and then the start's day is that line's alone; and no list is drawn for a counted place while anyone eligible waits, when no later deadline is left, on an event that is not scheduled, or for the Organizer, who has no «Retrimite» (2026-11-10, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a line of «La retrimitere» chosen and «Retrimite» confirmed, when the press reaches the server — at once, after a midnight, or days later from the same page — then the deadline stored is exactly the moment the line named: the form posts the moment it was drawn and the days are counted from it, never from a moment still to come; a `days` post without a usable draw moment counts from the press, as before; and the deadline still never moves earlier than it was, past the start, or at all for a counted place while anyone eligible waits (2026-11-10, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Retrimite» pressed on an open invitation, when the question is asked, then it names the outcome before anything is sent: the deadline kept, with its moment, or the chosen line in its own words — its day and hour, read from the list at the press — and, for a counted place while somebody waits, that the deadline stays, as before; each question carries the email line; and when a chosen line could not be kept — the deadline was moved later from another page since this one was drawn, or somebody joined the waiting list — the message after the press says the chosen deadline was not applied and that the one in force, which the email carries, is on the invitation's row (2026-11-10, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
